set.body: Offline measurement, no spend: how often the sampled-pair Qwen visual association (facet-assessment-20261022 acquisition) calls the same person different, or different people the same, on the rows where an independent visual inspection exists. Report by basis and by row, with denominators. Decides whether visual identity edges can be admitted from sampled pairs at all, or whether a track-level source is needed before S3c. Raw media and captions stay ignored.
set.title: [evidence-binding S3b] Measure sampled-pair visual association error on inspected rows
